verdict.rationale: Antigravity documents Scheduled Tasks: you define a cron schedule and agents start and run autonomously in the background. Supporting features add depth, including scheduled messages sent to agents while the user is away, worktree-isolated background folders, and headless CLI runs for CI pipelines. This is a recurring schedule, not a one-off action. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled background automations work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automate routine checks with Scheduled Tasks, simply define a cron schedule and the agents start and run autonomously in the background.
users can schedule messages to be sent to their agents while they’re away
Projects natively support Git worktrees, allowing agents to operate in isolated background folders.
Run Antigravity CLI non-interactively to script agent tasks, integrate with CI pipelines, and capture machine-readable output.
